content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboard advertising, broadband internet and insurance brokerage; no office property leasing business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, surveying and planning consulting sold to developers and agencies; not owning or leasing office buildings."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate and government tenants, with in-house leasing and property management."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government services contractor; does not own or lease real estate to tenants."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Installs and maintains building mechanical and electrical systems as a service provider, not an owner-lessor of office space."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contracting and service work; builds and services building systems rather than leasing property."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare REIT leasing senior housing and skilled nursing properties to care operators; different property type and tenants."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants under long-term leases, with direct property management."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases logistics warehouses and distribution centers; different property type and tenant base from office."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment rentals and holds securities; hospitality and residential, not office leasing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Manages REITs for fees as an external service provider; does not own or lease office buildings itself."}]}
